page.overview:
What is Durin VII?

Durin VII was the descendant of Thorin III and possibly the last of the House of Durin.

His birth was prophesied by the Dwarves at the conclusion of the Battle of Five Armies, that in the direct line of Dáin II there will be an heir, but the last of his line. Durin VII traveled from the Lonely Mountain to re-establish Khazad-dûm and root out the Orcs who lived there. After that, he re-founded the great Dwarf kingdom and his people prospered once more.

In , Prince Durin is the son of King Thorin III. In the game's story-line other Dwarves have been given that name and yet proved not to be the Father of the Longbeards returned, so a major part of his motivation is to prove whether he truly is or will be Durin VII.

At the onset of the War of the Ring, Thorin III sent Durin to the Iron Hills for his safety, where to his frustration the Prince had sat out the entire war in relative comfort. Seeking to prove himself, he follows a group of the Zhélruka dwarves on the pilgrimage to Ered Mithrin, where they believe their old strongholds can be reclaimed following Sauron's downfall. Despite his son disobeying his direct order, King Thorin puts his trust in him and sends to him both warriors from Erebor for reinforcements and the Red Axe of Dáin Ironfoot.
